tests: Large but simple: 1.1 million monthly users, read-mostly cached feeds, no accounts, two part-time people, no on-call. Maturity is the lifecycle stage only: six years and flat demand make it established, whatever the user count; the 'large-scale platform' label is contradicted by the brief; Ashford's 400,000 users are projected; the agency's 2-minute alert term is a performance target and a constraint, like the location-stays-on-phone promise and the $30,000 cap; the current backend and the feeds it depends on are keyed; rush-hour reliability, hosting cost and maintenance time are ranked goals.
